test_cast_from_pyobject_ptr: test the pybind11 cast_from_pyobject_ptr function to verify it returns the expected integer hash value
test_cast_object_to_pyobject_ptr: test casting a Python ValueHolder object to a PyObject pointer and verify the returned hash
test_call_callback_with_pyobject_ptr_arg: test passing a callback function that receives a PyObject pointer argument and returns a computed integer
test_return_list_pyobject_ptr_take_owner: test returning a list of PyObject pointers from C++ where Python takes ownership of the objects
test_trampoline_with_pyobject_ptr_return: test a Python subclass trampoline that overrides a C++ method returning PyObject pointers
